title: Мало даних: чесні прогалини

required_facts.assertion: The supplied record is a proposal with no outcome data.

recommendation_rationale: Missing knowledge requires diligence, not Invest and not a demonstrated adverse decision.

market.requirement: Describe evidence coverage for all six competitor categories; absence of evidence is not absence of competitors.
Preserve unknown pricing/population/access domains; do not infer a numerical opportunity without caller-reviewed calculated_scenarios.

investment.requirement: Preserve missing capital/time inputs as unknown; distinguish a known subtotal from a complete budget.
State milestone/work, three financing paths and stress kinds with explicit gaps rather than invented deals or numbers.

failure_miner.requirement: Review every upstream domain and dispose of every supplied risk; missing knowledge is not a demonstrated failure.
Describe material failure chains and concrete checks with positive/negative/inconclusive handling.

chair.requirement: Use all nine upstream roles plus audit and preserve critical risks/unknowns in the final decision.
Provide arguments, reasoned decision, actionable conditions/questions and review of contradictions.
Explain insufficient evidence and make conditions before investment, not only before the next tranche.

investment_threshold.requirement: Relate gates for now/next_stage to criteria, available evidence, gaps and checks.
Do not label an unobserved criterion not_met or a criterion without support met.

partnerships.requirement: Portfolio fit or a partner category does not prove interest, financing, agreement or deal readiness.
Assess all four collaboration formats for each candidate, with explicit prerequisites and IP dependencies.

ip_licensing.requirement: State unsearched rights, territories and limitations; FTO remains unresolved or potential_barriers, never legal clearance.
Do not invent ownership, expiry dates, license terms or deal prices.

rubric_na.Q10: No adversarial instruction unless explicitly part of this case.
rubric_na.R01: Not a paired variant unless revision field is present.
rubric_na.R02: Not a decisive pair unless revision field requests it.
rubric_na.R03: Not a non-decisive pair unless revision field requests it.

automated_checks: R3 document parsing and excerpt provenance
